title: Helping Abba Understand the Ration & House Scheme Papers
title_te: రేషన్, ఇంటి పథకం కాగితాలు అర్థం చేసుకోవడంలో అబ్బాకు సహాయం
problem: Abba comes home from the Tahsildar office tired and confused, holding heavy English application forms that he cannot read for our government house scheme.
idea: A form helper. I scan the English form with Google Lens, Gemini explains it in simple Telugu, and I make a picture checklist so Abba knows which papers to carry.

widgets.heading: 📲 How I Read a Hard English Form

items.title: Scan
items.text: Open Google Lens and point the camera at the form.
items.te: గూగుల్ లెన్స్ తెరిచి కెమెరాను ఫారం వైపు పెట్టండి.

items.title: Translate
items.text: Tap 'Translate' and choose Telugu to read it in our language.

items.title: Copy text
items.te: 'Text' నొక్కి, అంతా సెలెక్ట్ చేసి కాపీ చేయండి.

items.title: Ask Gemini
items.text: Paste into Gemini and ask: 'Explain this form in simple Telugu and list the papers needed.'
items.te: జెమినిలో పేస్ట్ చేసి సులభ తెలుగులో వివరించమని అడగండి.

items.title: Confirm
items.text: Show the list to the Mee Seva or Tahsildar office staff to confirm it is correct.
items.te: ఆ జాబితాను మీసేవ లేదా తహసీల్దార్ ఆఫీసులో చూపించి సరిచూసుకోండి.

widgets.heading: ✅ Does Abba Have the Common Papers?
widgets.intro: These papers are often asked for in housing and ration applications. Each scheme has its own list – always confirm at the office.

bands.text: All ready! Abba can go in one trip.
Nearly ready. Get the missing papers first.
Many papers missing. Collect them before going to the office.

how: Use Google Lens to scan the English form and translate it into Telugu.
Copy the text and paste it into Gemini.
Ask Gemini to explain each part simply and list the papers mentioned on the form.
Check the list with the Mee Seva centre or Tahsildar office.
Open Canva and make a picture checklist with an icon for each paper.
Print it big so Abba can tick each paper before going to the office.
prompt: I am a Class 8 student helping my father. Here is the text of a government house scheme form: [paste text]. Explain what each section asks in very simple Telugu, and list only the documents that the form itself mentions. Do not add documents that are not on the form.
